info.title: Tempolight API
info.description:
Everything the web app does goes through this API, so anything else can do it too: scripts, Home Assistant, a Stream Deck, a lighting desk. It is plain HTTP with JSON bodies on the same port as the web app (8080 by default).

**Auth.** Without a PIN lock every call works for everyone who can reach the port. With one, admin calls need an unlock token from `POST /api/unlock`, sent as the `x-tempolight-token` header (or `?token=`); guest-area calls work without one when that area is allowed in Settings.

**Origin rule.** Calls that change something are refused with 403 when a browser sends them from another website. Scripts and apps send no `Origin` and aren't affected. To send requests from the Try it panel of the docs site, an admin turns on **Integrations → Docs site → Let the docs site try API calls** (`PATCH /api/integrations/docs`).

**Errors** answer `{"error": "<a sentence for people>"}` with a 4xx or 5xx status.

**Live data** (status 4 times a second, LED previews, browser audio, the song clock) goes over one WebSocket at `/ws`, which OpenAPI can't describe: see the [WebSocket](/websocket) page.

Picks the next best look for the song playing (or the remembered song `id`). get.description:
Everything the web app draws: settings, show, devices, room, scenes, schedules (each with its next run), effects, styles, palettes, room presets and sound sources. Secrets are left out: `settings.mqtt.password` is blank and `hasPassword` says one is saved.

Layer.description: An accent effect drawn on top of the main one.

amount.description: How strongly the accent layer shows, 0 to 1.5.

mode.description: `auto` picks effects from the music; `manual` keeps `effect`.

effect.description: The effect shown in manual mode.

everyBeats.description: Automatic mode changes effect at most every this many beats, 1 to 64 (variety `show`).

variety.description: Automatic mode: `one` = one look per song (the default), `parts` = one effect each for calm parts, build-ups and drops, `show` = effects change with the song.

effect.description: An effect id. Setting it alone switches to manual mode.

Look.description: The song's look: one well-chosen effect (and palette) for the whole song.

main.description: The effect for the whole song.

drop.description: An effect of its own for the drops (variety `one`: only when the drops really stand out).

palette.description: A palette id; it steps on phrase lines (a chorus that comes back gets the same colour).

params.description: The look's own effect settings: speed follows the tempo (effects that don't need the beat), a little more intensity for energetic songs.

rejected.description: Effects turned down for this song (Not this one).

provisional.description: Picked while listening live to a song Tempolight doesn't know.

id.description: A remembered song's id (`m…`); default: the song playing.

color.description: `flash`, `hold`: the colour (none: white, or release the hold).

show.description: The show fields this scene sets (see Show).

time.description: `HH:MM`, or `sunrise`/`sunset` with an optional offset in minutes (needs a location in Settings).

DeviceHealth.description: The last check of a device. Fields depend on the kind of device.

host.description: Its address (`virtual` for a virtual room).

lightLatencyMs.description: This light's own delay set by hand, 0-500 ms (light timing). Left out: estimated.

light.description: Smart lights: what was found (for example `zones`) and their options.

anyOf.description: The LED count is read from WLED.

force.description: Add it even when it doesn't answer.

anyOf.title: Nanoleaf

maxAmps.description: Caps brightness to the power supply.

lightLatencyMs.description: Light timing: this light's own delay, 0-500 ms, instead of the estimate; `null`: estimated again.

hueArea.description: Hue: the entertainment area for fast mode.

Shape.description: A piece of the room on a 16 x 9 wall view, y = 0 at the top.

dev.description: The device id it belongs to.

from.description: Its first LED on the device; null: after the previous shape.

pts.description: Points `[x, y]` for lines; for `points`, one LED at each.

cover.description: Percent learned, for a partly learned song.

drops.description: When the drops come, in seconds.

phrase.description: The phrase grid: phrases of `len` bars from bar `first`.

merged.description: The same song was asked for already: a vote was added.

dynamics.description: How much brightness follows the song part.
